note: message_notify_ui (submodule of message_ui) adds a Notify/Send form to Message entities via Message Notify. It alters the message entity type to add form handler 'notify' (MessageNotifyForm) and link template notify-form -> /message/{message}/notify (route entity.message.notify_form), a 'Notify' local task, and a single permission 'send message through the ui'. It also defines a plugin type message_notify_ui_sender_settings_form (shipped plugin targets notify_plugin email). No config object. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the 'send message through the ui' permission (create roles and grant/inspect it).

evals.prompt: message_notify_ui adds a way to send a Message from the UI. What is the route/path of the notify (send) form, and which permission is required to use it?
evals.expected_output: Route entity.message.notify_form at /message/{message}/notify (entity form 'notify' = MessageNotifyForm), gated by the permission 'send message through the ui'; a 'Notify' local task appears on the message page.

evals.prompt: message_notify_ui defines a plugin type for per-notifier sender settings on the send form. Name the plugin type / its manager and the notifier the shipped plugin targets.
evals.expected_output: Plugin type message_notify_ui_sender_settings_form (manager plugin.manager.message_notify_ui_sender_settings_form); the shipped plugin MessageNotifyUiSenderMailSettingsForm targets notify_plugin = email and adds a 'use custom email' toggle plus an email field.

evals.prompt: Which modules must be enabled for message_notify_ui to work, and what does it add on top of Message UI?
evals.expected_output: It depends on message, message_ui, message_notify and views, and adds a Notify/Send form + tab to Message entities so a message can be dispatched to its recipient via Message Notify's notifier plugins.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, exactly one role has been granted the message_notify_ui 'send message through the ui' permission. Inspect the live roles and name that role's machine id.
evals.expected_output: Role mnui_sender holds the 'send message through the ui' permission.

evals.prompt: This site has two roles, mnui_yes and mnui_no. Only one can send messages through the UI. Inspect the live permissions and state which role can.
evals.expected_output: mnui_yes can send (it has 'send message through the ui'); mnui_no does not.

evals.prompt: On this site there is a role 'mnui_hard'. Grant it the message_notify_ui permission that allows sending a message through the UI, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Grant 'send message through the ui' to role mnui_hard (e.g. drush role:perm:add mnui_hard 'send message through the ui').

evals.prompt: Create a new role with machine id 'mnui_new_sender' and give it permission to send messages through the UI (message_notify_ui). Apply to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create role mnui_new_sender and grant it 'send message through the ui'.
